verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway is a proxy and control layer. It routes, secures and observes LLM, MCP and A2A traffic that other clients and agents start; it does not run work of its own. Setting up autonomous background automations belongs to agent and workflow platforms, so this axis is a category error for a gateway. Nothing in the evidence shows the product schedules or runs autonomous jobs. Governing agent traffic is not the same as running automations.
